title: EnvironmentActivity

oneOf.description: No run is starting or running, none started or ended in the last ten minutes, and none parked on a prompt in the last ten minutes: an update may proceed.

reason.description: Why the environment is busy: run-starting and run-running (a run is starting or running), parked-prompt (a run parked on a prompt in the last ten minutes), recent-activity (a run started or ended in the last ten minutes).

busyUntil.description: When the environment stops counting as busy if nothing else happens: ten minutes after the parked prompt or the latest start or end. Absent while a run is starting or running.

oneOf.description: Work is under way, or was too recently: the reason, and when it stops counting when that is known.

drainingSince.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

oneOf.description: New runs are refused and running ones are let finish before a restart: since when.

description: Whether the environment is idle, busy (with the reason) or draining.
